strategies.name: SPY 200d MA Breakout (5-day hold, canary)
strategies.description: Deliberately naive reference strategy: long SPY when price crosses above its 200-day moving average, held for a fixed 5 sessions regardless of price action, then closed flat. Exists as a pipeline canary -- it trades often enough to sanity-check the site is updating, unlike the rank butterfly's rare signals.
